assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Exact-looking metric values are retained only to satisfy deterministic recomputation tolerance; public-facing interpretation should use rounded values and provisional labels.
assumptions.impact: Prevents provisional geometry from being read as official area or statutory control.

assumptions.statement: Open Issue #846 records reproducible public-background checks that the OSM-mapped Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park does not intersect PROV-SITE-001 (nearest distance about 412.5 m) and a peer-reported Dazhongsi anchor discrepancy for PROV-KEY-003 of roughly 2 km until official key-area polygons are supplied.
assumptions.impact: Treat PROV-KEY-003 as an operating-section proxy only; Dazhongsi station-frontage, service-loop, land-use, public-space and metric claims must be relocated and recomputed when organizer key-area polygons or anchor coordinates are released.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service must keep an equivalent non-smartphone path, manual service window, appeal path and rollback trigger.
assumptions.impact: Protects older adults, children, disabled users, caregivers and users without smart devices.

assumptions.statement: v0.3 assets are score-raising design evidence, not official approval or implementation commitment.
assumptions.impact: Improves reviewability while preserving public-data and professional-confirmation boundaries.
